# Unit converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/unit-converter/

Convert lengths, weights, areas, volumes, temperatures and data sizes. Nepal land units are included alongside metric and imperial units.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Convert 16 aana to approximately one ropani, or convert meters to feet for a room measurement.

## Limits and checks

Land-unit definitions can vary by region. KB and KiB use different decimal and binary bases and are listed separately.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
